channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: TG4 announces extensive Allianz League coverage
item.description: TG4 will broadcast over 45 games during this year's Allianz Football and Hurling Leagues, up to and including all divisional finals.

item.title: Thirteen new additions to Tipp hurling panel
item.description: Tipperary hurling manager Liam Cahill has named a 43-man panel - which includes 13 players who weren't involved last year - for the upcoming Allianz League campaign.

item.title: Rochford recommits to Tullamore
item.description: Stephen Rochford will be involved with the Tullamore senior footballers again this year.

item.title: Geaney confirmed as Kerry football captain
item.description: Fresh from leading Dingle to All-Ireland club SFC glory last Sunday, Paul Geaney has been named as the new Kerry captain for the 2026.

item.title: Late Clarke goal seals Sigerson Cup quarter-final berth for Queen's University
item.description: Queen's University, Belfast moved into the quarter-finals of the Sigerson Cup thanks to a 1-14 to 0-12 win over rivals Ulster University in Jordanstown last night.

item.title: English double helps UL past DCU into Fitzgibbon Cup last eight
item.description: UL cruised into the quarter-finals of the Fitzgibbon Cup with a 4-24 to 1-20 victory over DCU at the DCU Sportsgrounds last night.

item.title: "The years after winning the All-Ireland, they have never won the league"
item.description: Former Kerry manager Eamonn Fitzmaurice says he expects the Kingdom to "go for it" in their upcoming Allianz Football League campaign.

item.title: "Every game will be cut-throat"
item.description: Antrim coach Seoirse Bulfin says the Saffrons are in for "a fair test" this weekend as they open their Allianz Hurling League Division 1B campaign away to Wexford.

item.title: Good start "vital" to Rebels' promotion hopes, says Collins
item.description: Former Cork forward Mark Collins says a good start will be "vital" for the Rebels if they are to get themselves in the hunt for promotion out of Division 2 in the Allianz Football League.

item.title: "We're striving to be our own team and win our own All-Irelands"
item.description: Dublin defender Greg McEneaney says the current crop of Dubs players are striving to be their own team.
